theorems.statement: ∀ (e F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), IntegrableOn e (Ioc σ ρ) → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun s ↦ e s * (F s - F σ)) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t ↦ F' t * ∫ τ in Ioc t ρ, e τ) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ ∫ t in Ioc σ ρ, F' t * ∫ τ in Ioc t ρ, e τ = ∫ s in Ioc σ ρ, e s * (F s - F σ)
